Tokai Teio said that she was truly able to 
enjoy running the Kikuka-sho.

However... faced with the reality of not 
becoming a "Triple Crown Umamusume," she 
quietly sheds tears.

However, realizing that challenging the 
Classic tier had helped her grow 
tremendously, she quickly regained her 
composure and set her sights on her next 
goal.

Her goal: the Tenno Sho (Spring). From 
here... Tokai Teio's new challenge begins.
